# miniz decompressor

Vendored from miniz 3.1.0, commit
`174573d60290f447c13a2b1b3405de2b96e27d6c`:
https://github.com/richgel999/miniz/tree/174573d60290f447c13a2b1b3405de2b96e27d6c

Only `miniz_tinfl.c` is compiled. Other upstream headers are needed by its
includes. Upstream files are unmodified; `miniz_export.h` is a local header
for static compilation. The MIT license is retained here and included in the
generated HTML alongside the decompressed Mermaid runtime.
